licence_position: FACTS AND POINTERS ONLY. None of these sites states an open licence, so this archive files what each work IS -- its shape, its author, what it covers, where to read it -- and reproduces none of its prose. The same line gen_amanye.py takes for Amanye Tenceli, and the same line the artwork ruling draws for Christopher Tolkien's plates: our measurement of a work is ours; the work is not.
corpus_position: The documents are NOT placed in corpus/. Samu's ruling of 11 August: a file belongs in corpus/ if and only if a claim about Arda could be cited to its text, and corpus/ is a CITABLE POPULATION that quoted_check and rule1_check both read. Scholarship not licensed to us cannot enter it, however useful. Filed here as pointers.
how_they_arrived: Both were recorded as unreachable for days and neither was down. This guest has no global IPv6 address while SLIRP advertises an IPv6 route, so curl preferred AAAA and reported 'Could not resolve host'. curl -4 plus a browser User-Agent took the reachable count from 2 of 11 to 9 of 11.
